reviews.title: A lot of fun until updated
reviews.text:
The game is a blast, if you have the hardware to run it. At only 455 MB size, it should run smoothly, unfortunately that’s not the case. After updating recently, it now just crashes upon loading the app.

This is typical of this developer unfortunately, as they have a few good games that I used to play, but due to poor optimization, it’s same issue as always; after updating, it kills the app. It also happened to Butcher Hero. I have declined to update Devour Hero Idle, so that I don’t lose access to that game as well.

I’ll keep checking after each updating in case the Devs see this and can’t fix the issue 🤞 playing on iPad Pro 1st GEN, which is most likely the issue, but it should be updated as such in the compatibility list.

reviews.title: I never write reviews
reviews.text:
But, I haven’t been able to find TOO much about the game, so I thought maybe it’s just really new? I’ve been pretty bad at this game, missing what I’m supposed to do and taking way longer than I should, but I’m LOVING the pacing so far. Challenges and scaling has been really satisfying. No lag, no ads, and no long time gates for things. The cons? Absolutely no hints or guides, no map even when a new area is introduced, no identifiers of where you can get extra upgrades, and the targeting is a little tough to get used to. But past that there are even more pro’s: the regions feel brand new and organic, the maze-like map makes it challenging, there’s no real consequence for trying again and again. Can’t wait to see what gets added, but if I HAD to suggest anything, it would be: swapping armor/weapons makes the stats display incorrectly for a bit in the item upgrade window, quest markers for places like research center, library, and the like make it seem like they’re only for the quests but not for power-ups. And finally, the little white circle lines to display cooldowns are SO hard to see sometimes. Can you give them like a black border or make them slightly darker? Other than that, having a blast!!!

Update: The VIP section says pharaoh center unlocks at vip2. I reached it, but then the pharaoh center says reach vip4 to open. Vip4 is for religion. Seems disingenuous if it’s not wrong. Will re-add a star if this is fixed.
